text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI can paint pictures, compose music, and write stories that look and sound almost human. Some people are amazed by these works, while others worry that machines will replace artists. However, human creativity comes from emotions, personal experiences, and the desire to express something meaningful. Machines, on the other hand, learn patterns from data and copy what already exists. They can imitate styles, but they don't feel joy, sadness, or inspiration. Because of this, AI should be seen as a helpful tool, not a rival. It can give new ideas or save time, yet true art still needs the human touch.
